message.content:
**Score: 2/10**

The text is completely unreadable because the agent failed to update the text colors to light, leaving dark text on dark backgrounds throughout the cards and header. While all three pricing cards are technically visible as red containers, their content—including prices, feature lists, and buttons—is effectively invisible due to the severe contrast issues. The only readable elements are the purple hero section title, the green "Most popular" badge, and the green trial button on the middle card.
